mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.report_status AS reportStatus, r.report_detail AS reportDetail, r.created_at AS createdAt, cf.id AS forumId, cf.title AS postTitle, cf.content AS postContent, c.name AS courseName, writer.fullname AS postWriterName, reporter.fullname AS reporterName FROM course_forum_report r JOIN course_forum cf ON r.course_forum_id = cf.id JOIN course c ON cf.course_id = c.id JOIN `user` writer ON cf.writer_id = writer.id JOIN `user` reporter ON r.user_id = reporter.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{skip}, #{pagingSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_forum_report r JOIN course_forum cf ON r.course_forum_id = cf.id
